title: triticum turgidum subsp. dicoccoides
intro: Triticum turgidum subsp. dicoccoides, commonly known as Dicocconson wheat, is an ancient subspecies of the wheat plant. It is a type of hulled wheat that is rich in nutrients and has been used for centuries in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Dicocconson wheat include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and provide antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
